name: Apricot Chicken Curry with Baby Spinach & Basmati Rice

instructions.primary_message: Rinse rice in a strainer until water runs clear and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, stir, and cover. Cook until liquid is absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
708 ml (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ cups basmati rice

instructions.primary_message: Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic and ginger. Medium dice apricots. Transfer everything to a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onion
3 cloves garlic
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger
24 dried apricots

instructions.primary_message: Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Trim excess fat and slice chicken into strips. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.362 kg chicken thighs, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add chicken and, stirring occasionally, cook until no longer pink, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Once chicken has been transferred, add more oil and onion to pan. Stirring frequently, cook until onion has softened, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry spinach and cilantro. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach
1 ½ small bunches cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Add apricots, garlic, ginger, paprika, coriander, and curry powder to pan. Stir with onions until fragrant, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp paprika
1 ½ tsp coriander
¾ tsp curry powder

instructions.primary_message: Return chicken to pan. Add coconut milk, spinach, and ½ of the cilantro (save the rest for garnishing). Stir until well combined. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook until curry thickens, 5-10 minutes.
Uncover rice and fluff with a fork.
To serve, place the rice in a bowl, top with curry, and garnish with remaining cilantro. Enjoy!
